findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command execution sinks in tqdm
 * @description Check for subprocess calls that could lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/command-execution
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential command execution sink"
findings.hypothesis: Check for subprocess or os.system calls that could lead to command injection
